entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: A powerful Zhalfirin general who led the royal army against Kaervek and later Phyrexia.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A country on Dominaria whose capital Jabari was born in.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: The enemy in the Mirage Wars, who escaped his Amber Prison.

entities.name: Sidar Mwigo
entities.description: A sidar who fell at Ufunguo.

entities.name: Hakim of Suq'Ata
entities.description: An ally who aided Jabari against Kaervek.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased Zhalfir out and later reconnected with Jabari.

events.summary: Jabari led the Zhalfirin armies in defending Tefemburu after Sidar Mwigo fell, destroying Kaervek's primary army.
events.quote: led the armies in defending the city of Tefemburu after Sidar Mwigo fell at Ufunguo

events.summary: Jabari was preparing to fight the Phyrexian Invasion when Teferi phased the country out.
events.quote: when the entire country was phased out by Teferi

events.summary: Teferi reconnected with Jabari and Queen Wezna in Zhalfir.
events.quote: He reconnected with Jabari and Queen Wezna

events.summary: Jabari commanded Zhalfir's armies in the attack on New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Jabari commanded the armies of Zhalfir in their attack on New Phyrexia
